description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces for managing a hash table for names within an indexing system, likely related to file or directory management. It declares functions for finding, checking existence, adjusting case, adding, removing, and freeing hash entries, as well as a macro for existence check.

methods.name: index_dir_find
methods.description: Finds the directory in the index by name and length, optionally returning its canonical path.

methods.name: index_dir_exists
methods.description: Macro that checks if a directory exists in the index by calling index_dir_find with NULL for canonical path.

methods.name: adjust_dirname_case
methods.description: Adjusts the case of the directory name in the index.

methods.name: index_file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in the index, returning the cache entry.

methods.name: test_lazy_init_name_hash
methods.description: Tests the lazy initialization of the name hash data structure.

methods.name: add_name_hash
methods.description: Adds a cache entry to the name hash.

methods.name: remove_name_hash
methods.description: Removes a cache entry from the name hash.

methods.name: free_name_hash
methods.description: Frees the name hash data structure.
